title: EUrea launches data-free AI heating 6,000 homes in Geneva #eurea #privacyai #greenenergy
description: Urea launched an AI system that collects zero user data while repurposing its server heat to warm over 6,000 apartments in Geneva. Fully Swiss, hosted locally, and powered by 100% renewable energy, Urea ensures complete privacy with no data profiling, resale, or retention beyond ephemeral use. Designed to analyze PDFs, images, and transcribe audio with a fast, fluid interface, EUrea prioritizes user privacy and environmental impact over raw computational power. While it may not match the complexity of larger American AI models, its innovative approach demonstrates a sustainable path for AI development that respects user data sovereignty and reduces carbon footprint through heat recovery. This initiative highlights a growing market shift towards privacy-centric and eco-friendly AI solutions, setting a new standard for responsible technology deployment in sensitive regulatory environments. #EUreaAI #SwissAI #PrivacyFirstAI #RenewableEnergy #DataSovereignty #EcoFriendlyTech #AIHeating #SustainableAI #GenevaTech #ZeroDataCollection #PrivacyTech #GreenAI #AIInnovation #ClimateTech #SwissInnovation

top_reply.author: @J.samsonite
top_reply.text:
I just downloaded the app and asked the AI model "how do I make sure that I am in ephemeral mode" and it responded by saying this:

"Euria operates in ephemeral mode by default, meaning all your interactions are processed in-memory for the duration of your session and are not stored permanently or used to train models. There is no specific setting you need to toggle to activate this; it is the standard behavior of the service. Your data is not retained after the session ends, ensuring privacy and confidentiality without any action required on your part." 

I've gotta admit that this creator choosing to say "in ephemeral mode" makes it sound like there are other modes that you need to look out for 😅
